Seminar Title:

Quasi-Semiregular Elements in Permutation Groups and Vertex-Transitive Graphs

Seminar Type:

Ranjit Mehatari

Abstract: 

	An element of a permutation group is called quasi-semiregular if it has a unique fixed point and acts semiregularly on the remaining points. In this work, we investigate the existence of quasi-semiregular elements in finite transitive permutation groups and Cayley graphs. We first provide a complete classification of finite transitive permutation groups of orders pn, pq , 4p, and 2p2 that admit quasi-semiregular elements. We then investigate the existence of quasi-semiregular automorphisms in Cayley graphs of finite groups. In particular, we completely classify all connected, undirected Cayley graphs of finite abelian groups with valency at most 5 that admit a quasi-semiregular automorphism. Finally, we extend our investigation to imprimitive permutation groups and automorphism groups of circulant graphs, obtaining several structural and classification results.
